entries.31a77d7cc8e29ca4: It is a business that securely collects IT equipment no longer used by corporations, and performs data erasure and proper disposal. High-value equipment is productized at a Technical Center and sold as reused products, while equipment that is difficult to reuse is disassembled into materials and sold to recycling companies that meet the company's audit standards. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥3,297 million.
entries.87ba526086fb0d9c: It is a business that manufactures, sells and provides maintenance services for the audio guide device “Earphone Guide®”, mainly for the tourism industry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥360 million.
